literal_meaning: অ-ব্রাহ্মণের দীর্ঘ ফোঁটা (non-Brahmin's long tuft or drop)
figurative_meaning_en: Excessive pretense of a fake Brahmin
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে অব্রাহ্মণের দীর্ঘফোঁটা, সবসময় নিজেকে বড় দেখানোর চেষ্টা করে।
example_sentences_in_english: He is a non-Brahmin's long tuft, always trying to show off pretentiously.
His speech shows the excessive pretense of a fake Brahmin.
history: Refers to the traditional tuft of hair (shikha) worn by Brahmins in Hindu tradition, mocking a non-Brahmin's exaggerated imitation for show.
note: Idiom highlights caste-based pretensions in Bengali society.
